units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 6:4">B. Kam. VI, 4</cite> <he>השולח את הב׳ ביד וכ׳</he> he who sends out a deaf and dumb, an idiot or a minor with burning materials (live coal &c.) thus causing or ordering a conflagration.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 6:4">Ib.</cite> <he>השולח את הב׳</he> he who starts a fire (himself). Ib. 60ᵇ, v. <cite ref="B01062"><he>בָּעַר</he></cite>.
